metadata.title: Divorced Before The IPO
metadata.subtitle: My husband served divorce papers 12 hours before his company's IPO—not knowing I'm the silent investor holding 51% veto power.

nodes.text: 9:00 PM · Twelve hours before NovaAI rings the stock exchange bell. Ethan slides a thick divorce packet across your kitchen island.
Sign tonight, {{player_name}}. Take the $50,000 buyout. Tomorrow I become a billionaire, and Serena’s father is taking me global.
I coded your core algorithm for four years while you slept, Ethan. And you’re dumping me the night before the IPO?
Please, {{player_name}}, stop clinging. Ethan needs a wife who understands Wall Street, not a stay-at-home coder.
Just make sure she signs before midnight so she can’t claim a single IPO share.

nodes.prompt: Ethan clicks his Montblanc pen impatiently:

options.label: Sign immediately & smile
options.player_reply_text: Done. Keep your $50K—you’re going to need it by 9:30 AM.

options.label: Alert Exchange Counsel to invoke 51% veto

nodes.text: You sign cleanly, drop your wedding ring on the counter, and walk out without looking back.
Finally! Enjoy your quiet little life, {{player_name}}.
As your pen lifts off the page, your private terminal sends a Level-1 Freeze to the Exchange Listing Committee.
Veto armed, {{player_name}}. As 51% Series-Seed Silent Angel, you can halt NovaAI’s bell with one tap.
On your way to the elevator, your encrypted phone flashes with an urgent cyber-audit alert about Serena.
Wait—check the server logs! Serena’s father isn’t taking Ethan global. He’s secretly shorting NovaAI for a rival fund!

nodes.headline: The Trojan Bride
nodes.teaser_text: Ethan dumped his secret 51% angel investor to marry a corporate spy planted to bankrupt him at the opening bell.

nodes.text: 9:15 AM · Stock Exchange Podium. Ethan and Serena wave at TV cameras—fifteen minutes before the bell.
Rachel whispers fast: "Serena just uploaded NovaAI’s source code to an offshore rival server five minutes ago!"
Alert flashes: "Source code exfiltration detected from Serena’s VIP badge! IP kill-switch ready."
Good thing my core algorithm has a cryptographic ownership lock. Wait until Ethan steps up to the podium.

nodes.caption: 51% Silent Angel Super-Voting Charter & Sole IP Assignment — signed by {{player_name}}.

nodes.prompt: Ethan grabs the gavel to ring the IPO bell:

options.label: Trigger the IPO Halt across every screen
options.player_reply_text: Halt the listing. Invoke Section 9 IP Protection.

options.label: Walk onto the podium & take the mic live

nodes.text: BOOM. Every ticker board in the exchange flashes crimson: "NOVAAI IPO SUSPENDED — MAJORITY SHAREHOLDER VETO."
What the hell?! Who is the 51% silent angel?! We’re live on national TV!!
You stride onto the balcony podium in a sharp charcoal suit. Cameras swing toward you as the exchange president bows.
{{player_name}}?! Security! Ethan’s crazy ex-wife broke onto the trading floor!
The Exchange President hands you the microphone and announces: "Please welcome the 51% Founder and Controlling Shareholder of NovaAI!"
NO... {{player_name}}?! YOU were the silent angel who funded my seed round?!

nodes.headline: Frozen On Live TV
nodes.teaser_text: Ethan’s knees give out on national television—while Serena panics because her stolen code just triggered a federal alarm.

nodes.text: 9:28 AM · Backstage VIP room. Ethan collapses into a chair, clutching his head as reporters pound on the glass.
{{player_name}}, I didn’t know! Tear up the divorce! Let’s restart the IPO together right now!
Too late, Ethan. And you should worry less about our divorce and more about what your fiancée just uploaded.

nodes.transcript: [frantic voice note intercepted by security] "Dad, the code is encrypted with a watermark—it locked our rival servers and pinged the police!"

nodes.text: Ethan is useless now—get the jet ready before they trace the short-sell account!

nodes.prompt: Ethan stares in horror at Serena’s intercepted message:

options.label: Let police arrest Serena & her father
options.player_reply_text: She never loved you, Ethan. She was hired to gut NovaAI.

options.label: Squeeze her father’s short position for $40M

nodes.text: Cyber-crime officers escort Serena out of the VIP lounge in handcuffs while Ethan watches in stunned silence.
Both Serena and her father are in custody. Trade-secret theft caught red-handed!
You lift the IPO halt the second Serena is cuffed—sending NovaAI’s stock soaring 210% and wiping out her father’s short fund!
Short-squeeze complete! Their rival fund just lost $40M in twelve minutes!
Ethan drops to his knees beside your chair, his face drenched in regret.
You even saved the company from Serena’s trap... {{player_name}}, please let me stay on as CEO.

nodes.headline: Board Vote Of One
nodes.teaser_text: With 51% super-voting power, you hold Ethan’s career in the palm of your hand.

nodes.text: 11:00 AM · Emergency Shareholder Meeting. The boardroom sits hushed as you take the head chair.
Motion on the floor: remove Ethan for gross breach of fiduciary duty and appoint {{player_name}} as CEO.
Wait—you’re kicking me out of my own company?! What do I get?!

nodes.caption: Wire confirmed: $50,000 severance — the exact buyout Ethan offered you last night.

nodes.text: She really gave me my own $50,000 buyout back...

nodes.prompt: Ethan stands at the boardroom door with his cardboard box:

options.label: Wish him luck & close the glass doors
options.player_reply_text: Enjoy your quiet little life, Ethan.

options.label: Offer him a junior coder role—at minimum wage

nodes.text: You turn back to the cheering engineering team—the people who actually built NovaAI.
Everyone in engineering just got double stock options. Let’s build the future.
A ripple of stifled laughter runs around the table as Ethan’s face burns crimson.
I’ll never forget this, {{player_name}}... I threw away gold for fool’s gold.
Outside the trading floor, the NovaAI banner unfurls with your name gleaming in lights.
Market cap just crossed $1.2 billion, Boss. Ready for your closing bell?

nodes.headline: The Closing Bell
nodes.teaser_text: At 4:00 PM, you step back onto the podium—this time as Wall Street’s newest self-made billionaire.

nodes.text: 4:00 PM · Stock Exchange Balcony. Confetti rains over the trading floor as you strike the closing bell.
Closed up 185% on Day One! Every tech magazine is calling you the Queen of the Algorithm!
Best divorce present I ever received.

nodes.transcript: [clinking glasses] "Prosecutors just indicted Serena and her dad for insider short-selling. Zero bail!"

nodes.text: Watching you ring the bell from a coffee shop TV... I’m sorry.

nodes.prompt: A reporter asks what inspired your historic IPO:

options.label: Dedicate it to every silent builder
options.player_reply_text: To everyone who built the engine while someone else took the credit—it’s your turn.

options.label: Thank your ex for freeing your schedule

nodes.text: The entire trading floor erupts in a standing ovation.
Never let anyone undervalue your code—or your worth.
Reporters burst out laughing as your quote instantly becomes the headline of the decade.
Iconic! Wall Street will remember today forever, {{player_name}}!
Sunlight gleams off the golden bell as NovaAI’s ticker climbs higher into the afternoon sky.
Congratulations, CEO {{player_name}}. Welcome to the billion-dollar club.

nodes.headline: Act 2 · The Midnight Short-Attack
nodes.teaser_text: Before the IPO confetti even hits the floor, Rachel rushes in pale-faced—an offshore Cayman fund just claimed Ethan secretly pledged NovaAI’s core patent as loan collateral!

nodes.text: 8:15 PM · NovaAI Executive War Room. Red stock tickers flash across the glass wall as after-hours trading plunges 28% in ten minutes.
An offshore hedge fund called Apex Cayman just published a 40-page short report—claiming NovaAI doesn’t even own its AI kernel!

nodes.caption: Purported Patent Lien Agreement bearing Ethan’s former CEO signature—dated two months before the IPO.

nodes.text: Look closely at the font kerning on the date line, Rachel. That document wasn’t signed two months ago—someone forged the timestamp this afternoon.
Enjoy your five hours as a billionaire, {{player_name}}! My father’s syndicate will buy NovaAI for pennies by Friday.

nodes.prompt: Institutional investors are flooding your hotline asking whether to dump shares:

options.label: Issue an immediate patent-ownership audit
options.player_reply_text: Release our patent registry hash immediately—let every fund manager verify zero liens existed at 9 AM today.

options.label: Trace Apex Cayman’s prime broker silently
options.player_reply_text: Don’t just calm the market—have our forensic accountants trace who funded Apex Cayman’s short margin deposit!

nodes.text: Smart move! The sell-off just slowed from -28% to -11%—institutions are waiting for tomorrow morning’s proof!
Jackpot! The short margin was wired from a holding company controlled by Serena’s father three hours before Ethan handed you divorce papers!
Before you can celebrate the lead, Rachel’s encrypted exchange terminal chimes with an urgent clearinghouse notice.
Uh oh—Apex Cayman just filed a formal petition to halt NovaAI trading at tomorrow’s opening bell!

nodes.headline: Twelve Hours To Trading Halt
nodes.teaser_text: If the Exchange halts NovaAI tomorrow morning, the hostile syndicate triggers a default clause that strips you of control.

nodes.text: 11:50 PM · NovaAI 42nd Floor. City lights flicker below as your private counsel line rings with an urgent Exchange alert.
The Listing Committee meets at 8 AM sharp! They say Apex Cayman produced a notarized copy of Ethan’s patent lien—we need proof of forgery tonight!

nodes.transcript: [urgent voicemail] "Call me back immediately! The Listing Committee gave us until 8 AM to disprove Ethan’s notarized lien or trading halts!"

nodes.text: Wait—Ethan never had my cryptographic signing key. Every real NovaAI patent assignment requires dual-key hardware verification inside our datacenter.
Hey {{player_name}}... it’s Ethan on a new number. Meet me for five minutes—I can make this entire short-attack vanish tonight.

nodes.prompt: Your scheming ex-husband suddenly wants a midnight deal:

options.label: String him along via text to get proof
options.player_reply_text: Interesting offer, Ethan. Spell out exactly what you signed with Apex Cayman—and what you want in return.

options.label: Ping his burner & lock datacenter access
options.player_reply_text: Rachel, log his text as attempted extortion—and check our datacenter badge logs! Why is he so confident tonight?

nodes.text: Reinstate me as Co-CEO and drop the fraud charges! Do that and I’ll sign an affidavit saying the lien was a "draft."
Oh no! Our security system just flagged an unauthorized physical login attempt inside Cold-Storage Rack 3 twenty minutes ago!
Suddenly, your laptop chimes with a red NovaAI Datacenter Intrusion Alert—someone is trying to spoof your hardware signing key RIGHT NOW.
He’s not trying to negotiate—he’s stalling me while his accomplices break into our server room!

nodes.headline: Ethan’s Midnight Stalling
nodes.teaser_text: While Ethan begs on a burner phone, two shadows are plugging a rogue device straight into NovaAI’s core servers.

nodes.text: 12:10 AM · NovaAI Security Ops. You trigger the remote biometric lockdown while Ethan’s burner messages keep pouring in.
Stop being stubborn, {{player_name}}! Sign the Co-CEO memo in five minutes or NovaAI wakes up worthless tomorrow!
Hurry up—Serena’s dad promised to wipe my $8M gambling debt ONLY if NovaAI collapses before 9 AM!
Too slow on the unsend button, Ethan. So that’s why you threw away four years of marriage—to pay off an $8M secret debt?
Security guards just reached the server floor—the intruders bolted out the emergency stairwell, leaving a cloned USB dongle still blinking in Rack 3!

nodes.prompt: The rogue USB dongle is still transmitting to an external IP:

options.label: Pull the drive & preserve fingerprints
options.player_reply_text: Tell security to bag that USB in an evidence sleeve—and pull the corridor CCTV right now!

options.label: Feed a honeypot file to trace their IP
options.player_reply_text: Wait—let my firewall inject a watermarked dummy key into that USB so we can trace the exact terminal receiving it!

nodes.text: Bagged! And our backup night-vision camera caught BOTH intruders standing right beside Rack 3!
Locked onto their endpoint! The receiver IP sits inside a private villa owned by Serena’s father!
The datacenter night-vision feed finishes decrypting on your screen, revealing two unmistakable silhouettes.
Look at the hallway cam, {{player_name}}—they broke into a federal-regulated IPO datacenter. That’s prison time!

nodes.headline: Shadows In Rack 3
nodes.teaser_text: One frame from the server room camera is about to blow the lid off the entire hostile takeover.

nodes.text: 12:40 AM · NovaAI Forensic Desk. You zoom in on the encrypted hallway frame while economic police investigators connect to your video call.

nodes.caption: Datacenter corridor CCTV (11:39 PM): Two intruders carrying a hardware keylogger toward Cold-Storage Rack 3.

nodes.text: Notice the reflective watch strap on the left figure—the exact limited-edition chronograph Ethan wore on our wedding day.
That wasn’t me! Anyone can buy a watch—good luck proving I was anywhere near that building!
Oh, he forgot one tiny detail: the intruder used an old executive RFID badge to enter the freight elevator—registered to Ethan’s personal ID!

nodes.prompt: Investigators ask where to strike first before dawn:

options.label: File the CCTV & badge log with Exchange
options.player_reply_text: Send the CCTV frame and badge audit straight to the Listing Committee—show them who is REALLY tampering with our patent records!

options.label: Subpoena Apex Cayman’s offshore wire log
options.player_reply_text: Hit their wallet! Ask economic police to pull the exact wire transfer that funded Apex Cayman’s short account!

nodes.text: Committee Chair just replied: trading halt is SUSPENDED pending our morning evidence presentation!
The international clearing bank just released the SWIFT trace—you need to see the sender’s name right now!
A crisp bank clearance receipt loads onto your monitor, linking Ethan’s divorce night directly to the hostile short-attack.
Two million dollars wired as a "consulting fee" straight to Ethan’s secret account—two hours before he asked you for a divorce.

nodes.headline: The Two-Million-Dollar Payoff
nodes.teaser_text: The wire receipt doesn’t just expose Ethan—it drags Serena and her father straight into an insider-trading conspiracy.

nodes.text: 1:20 AM · NovaAI Boardroom. Rachel projects the decrypted international wire slip across the wall while Serena’s phone suddenly goes active.

nodes.caption: Verified offshore transfer: $2,000,000 wired from Serena’s father’s shell fund to Ethan’s secret account on divorce night.

nodes.text: So Ethan wasn’t just unfaithful—he was paid two million to sabotage his own company’s IPO from the inside.
How on earth did you pull private Cayman wire records?! You’re bluffing—those accounts are shielded!
Not when economic police flag them for securities fraud, Serena. Your father’s broker is already sweating bullets.

nodes.prompt: Serena is rattled—how do you press the psychological advantage?

options.label: Send Serena a cropped wire timestamp
options.player_reply_text: Recognize that 6:00 PM routing code, Serena? Better call your father before the morning bell.

options.label: Audit NovaAI’s 4-year-old Git commit log
options.player_reply_text: Wait—if Ethan was willing to sell us out tonight, check our VERY FIRST Git repository from four years ago. What else did he hide?

nodes.text: Wait... Dad told me Ethan signed off cleanly! He didn’t tell me our family name was on the routing ledger!
Hold everything! I just found an encrypted pre-incorporation memo hidden in the legacy archive—and Serena’s father’s signature is on it!
Seconds later, a frantic voice note lands in the chat—Serena accidentally hit record while screaming at her father’s broker.
Don’t breathe—play this audio right now! Serena just hot-mic’d their entire bankruptcy scheme!

nodes.headline: The Hot-Mic Confession
nodes.teaser_text: Serena’s own panic hands you the smoking gun—and unlocks a shocking four-year-old secret about how NovaAI really began.

nodes.text: 1:45 AM · NovaAI War Room. The room goes dead silent as Serena’s accidental ten-second voice message echoes through the speakers.

nodes.transcript: [panicked yelling] "Tell Dad to double the short position! If {{player_name}} proves Ethan stole her professor’s v1 prototype, we lose the patent buyout!"

nodes.text: Freeze that audio! Replay what she just said about my late professor’s v1 prototype!
Wait... Ethan always claimed HE coded the v1 foundation before you joined! Was that a lie from day one?!
Ignore that voice note! My phone pocket-dialed—none of that is admissible!

nodes.prompt: You pull up the oldest encrypted commit in NovaAI’s 2022 repository:

options.label: Decrypt the original author metadata
options.player_reply_text: Strip off Ethan’s re-committed header and inspect the raw binary author signature from four years ago!

options.label: Cross-check Ethan’s pre-IPO side contract
options.player_reply_text: Rachel, open that legacy memo you found—who paid Ethan to swipe my professor’s lab prototype four years ago?

nodes.text: Oh my god... My late professor’s university lab watermark is still embedded in line 14—and Ethan’s login wasn’t even created yet!
Unbelievable! Serena’s father funded Ethan’s very first seed check—on the secret condition he marry you to get your algorithm!
The floor seems to tilt beneath your feet as four years of "love" shatter into a cold corporate heist.
He didn’t just betray me before the IPO. He married me to finish my late professor’s life work—then planned to throw me away the moment the code went live.

nodes.headline: Mid-Season Twist · The Stolen Legacy
nodes.teaser_text: Your entire marriage was a four-year corporate con—and now you’re going to burn their entire syndicate to the ground.

nodes.text: 2:15 AM · NovaAI War Room. Tears dry to steel as you lay the original university lab ledger beside Ethan’s forged patent lien.
Look at this, Rachel: my late professor willed the v1 prototype’s intellectual property exclusively to ME—his chief PhD fellow.
Which means Ethan NEVER had legal title to pledge the patent to Apex Cayman in the first place! Their entire short-attack is built on stolen property!
Don’t push me, {{player_name}}! I’m at the private jet terminal right now—if you don’t wire $10M in ten minutes, I’m leaking a fake backdoor memo to every news desk!
Go ahead and try to board that plane, Ethan. Economic police already have your datacenter CCTV and your two-million-dollar wire.

nodes.prompt: Ethan is minutes from boarding a chartered flight out of the country:

options.label: Forward the extortion text to airport police
options.player_reply_text: Send his threat straight to the economic police aviation desk—flag his passport before takeoff!

options.label: Prepare a zero-knowledge proof for 9 AM
options.player_reply_text: Better yet—package my professor’s original cryptographic hash with the wire trail so we crush Apex Cayman at the opening bell!

nodes.text: Airport customs just locked the jet bridge! Ethan is trapped inside the VIP lounge!
Everything is notarized and queued for the Exchange press wire! Apex Cayman is about to walk straight into the biggest short-squeeze of the decade!
Suddenly, your desk phone flashes red—Ethan is calling directly from the locked airport lounge.
He just saw the airport officers outside the glass! Let him call—every word will tighten the noose.

nodes.headline: Trapped At The Terminal
nodes.teaser_text: Cornered at the airport gate, Ethan makes one final, unhinged call—before smashing his burner phone to hide the evidence.

nodes.text: 2:40 AM · Rain lashes the airport tarmac as Ethan’s frantic call lights up your screen.
[voice cracking] "Call off the airport police, {{player_name}}! Remember how we stayed up eating ramen in that tiny apartment? Don’t send me to prison!"

nodes.transcript: [sobbing voicemail] "Please don’t let them arrest me! Serena’s dad forced my hand—I’m smashing this phone before they search me!"

nodes.text: You threw away that tiny apartment the night you took two million from Serena’s father, Ethan. Smashing your phone won’t erase a single byte.
Airport security just detained him! He stomped his burner phone into pieces right by the boarding gate—wait, our forensic team grabbed the SIM and last GPS ping!

nodes.prompt: Ethan’s shattered burner phone is on the forensic table:

options.label: Extract the 11:39 PM datacenter GPS ping
options.player_reply_text: Pull the tower triangulation from 11:39 PM—put Ethan physically inside NovaAI’s server room beyond any doubt!

options.label: Recover his deleted texts to Serena’s dad
options.player_reply_text: Clone the damaged flash chip—pull the last encrypted message Ethan sent to Serena’s father before the smash!

nodes.text: Bullseye! The GPS pin sits dead-center over Cold-Storage Rack 3 at 11:39 PM—matching the CCTV timestamp to the second!
Recovered! He texted Serena’s father: "Keylogger planted, double the Cayman short at 9 AM!" That’s airtight conspiracy!
The forensic map loads onto your tablet—a cracked screen with one glowing red coordinate that seals Ethan’s fate.
Ethan is in custody. Now let’s finish off Apex Cayman when the opening bell rings at 9:00 AM.

nodes.headline: The Shattered Proof
nodes.teaser_text: One recovered GPS log links Ethan’s smashed phone straight to the datacenter heist—and sets up a legendary Wall Street trap.

nodes.text: 6:30 AM · NovaAI Trading Command. Dawn breaks as Rachel uploads the recovered GPS evidence and prepares your counter-strike.

nodes.caption: Forensic extraction from Ethan’s smashed burner: exact 11:39 PM GPS lock inside NovaAI Datacenter Rack 3.

nodes.text: Apex Cayman doesn’t know Ethan was arrested at 2 AM! They just doubled their short bet in pre-market—putting $300M of borrowed stock on the line!
Perfect. Let them borrow every single share they can find. At 9:01 AM, we publish the cryptographic proof AND the arrest warrant simultaneously.
Why isn’t Ethan answering?! Dad just put our entire family estate up as collateral for this morning’s short!

nodes.prompt: Two hours until the 9:00 AM opening bell:

options.label: Invite sovereign funds for a buyback
options.player_reply_text: Call our three sovereign institutional partners—brief them under NDA so they’re ready to sweep the order book at 9:01 AM!

options.label: Live-stream the zero-knowledge proof
options.player_reply_text: Book a live financial network slot at 9:01 AM—I’m verifying my late professor’s cryptographic key live in front of millions of traders!

nodes.text: All three sovereign funds committed $400M in buy orders! The moment our press release drops, Apex Cayman is vaporized!
Booked! The anchor just teased "NovaAI CEO’s Bombshell Broadcast"—traders are glued to their terminals!
Morning sunlight floods the trading floor as the countdown clock ticks down to 9:00 AM—Act 3 begins.
They tried to short my life’s work. Now watch them drown in their own margin call.

nodes.headline: Act 3 · The Short-Squeeze Trap
nodes.teaser_text: At 9:01 AM sharp, one cryptographic click is about to turn a $300M short-attack into financial annihilation.

nodes.text: 9:01 AM · Live Financial Broadcast Studio. Sunlight streams through floor-to-ceiling glass as you step onto the anchor desk.
Good morning, markets. On screen is the immutable 2022 cryptographic signature proving 100% of NovaAI’s core patent belongs to me and our shareholders—zero liens exist.
And the Exchange Regulatory Commission just posted the official bulletin: the alleged Cayman lien is declared a criminal forgery—and Ethan is under arrest!
WAIT—STOP THE BROADCAST! NovaAI just jumped +35% in sixty seconds! Our broker is liquidating my father’s accounts!
You told me to enjoy five hours as a billionaire, Serena. Hope you enjoy the next five minutes.

nodes.prompt: NovaAI’s stock chart turns into a vertical green rocket:

options.label: Announce NovaAI’s $200M enterprise deal
options.player_reply_text: One more announcement for our investors: three global banking groups just signed multi-year AI licensing deals with NovaAI this morning!

options.label: Name Serena’s father’s shell fund on air
options.player_reply_text: For transparency, regulators have already subpoenaed the shell company behind Apex Cayman’s illegal short-attack—justice will be swift.

nodes.text: +62%!! Trading just hit an upward circuit breaker! Apex Cayman’s short losses just crossed HALF A BILLION DOLLARS!
Instant carnage! Serena’s father’s bank partners just froze his credit lines live on the wire!
Across the trading floor, cheers erupt as NovaAI’s market cap surges past $3.2 billion—while Apex Cayman’s margin desk goes into meltdown.
You just pulled off the cleanest short-squeeze in market history! And look—Serena is blowing up your phone!

nodes.headline: The Bear Trap Springs
nodes.teaser_text: With her family empire vaporizing by the second, Serena makes one desperate choice to save herself from prison.

nodes.text: 10:30 AM · NovaAI Green Room. Financial anchors replay your broadcast on loop as Apex Cayman formally announces insolvency.
Apex Cayman just defaulted on its prime broker! Liquidators are seizing every asset pledged by Serena’s father—including their penthouse and yacht!
{{player_name}}, please pick up! Economic police just arrived at my father’s office—I swear I only followed his orders!
[via defense lawyer] Ethan requests an emergency private settlement before the 1:00 PM Exchange Regulatory Tribunal.
Tell Ethan’s lawyer there is no private settlement. He wanted a public humiliation on IPO morning—now he gets a public tribunal.

nodes.prompt: How do you handle Serena’s frantic plea for a cooperation deal?

options.label: Tell her to surrender all files to police
options.player_reply_text: If you want leniency, Serena, turn over every forged contract and email to economic police—not to me.

options.label: Demand she confirm the stolen lab prototype
options.player_reply_text: Sign a sworn confession admitting Ethan stole my late professor’s v1 prototype—clear my mentor’s name forever.

nodes.text: She’s cracking! Serena’s lawyer just contacted prosecutors offering to testify against BOTH Ethan and her own father!
I’ll sign it right now! I have the original 2022 email where Ethan bragged about copying your professor’s drive!
Before you can close the folder, your phone rings—Serena is calling in tears from the back of a lawyer’s car.
Answer it on speaker—let’s hear the last pillar of their syndicate crumble.

nodes.headline: The Panic Call
nodes.teaser_text: Serena’s tearful breakdown hands you the final missing piece—just in time for the 1:00 PM Regulatory Tribunal.

nodes.text: 11:05 AM · NovaAI Executive Suite. Sunlight shines coldly on your conference table as Serena’s frantic call rings through.
[sobbing] "I just handed the 2022 emails to prosecutors! Ethan is telling everyone it was ALL my father’s idea—he’s throwing me under the bus!"

nodes.transcript: [crying voicemail] "I gave prosecutors the 2022 theft emails! Ethan is blaming everything on us—I’ll testify at 1 PM to make sure he goes down!"

nodes.text: Remember when you told me Ethan needed a wife who understood finance instead of a coder? Turns out you both failed basic math.
Prosecutors just confirmed receipt of the 2022 email! Every single count—securities fraud, IP theft, and datacenter break-in—is now 100% locked.

nodes.prompt: The 1:00 PM Exchange Regulatory Tribunal is about to convene:

options.label: Walk in calmly with your professor’s binder
options.player_reply_text: Bring my late professor’s original research binder. Today his work finally gets the credit Ethan stole.

options.label: File a $100M civil damages claim on Apex
options.player_reply_text: Attach a civil restitution claim against Apex Cayman’s seized assets—every dollar goes straight into a student AI fellowship!

nodes.text: Not a dry eye among the university faculty watching the livestream! You’re honoring him the best way possible.
Filed and front-page news! Even retail investors are applauding you across every trading forum!
Inside the glass-walled Tribunal Hall, Ethan sits pale in a rumpled suit as you take the lead witness microphone.
Ready for the final bell, Ethan? This time, you’re not ringing it.

nodes.headline: The Emergency Hearing
nodes.teaser_text: Under glaring tribunal lights, Ethan tries one last lie—right before Serena walks through the doors as star witness.

nodes.text: 1:00 PM · Exchange Regulatory Tribunal. Cameras click furiously as Ethan grips the table, insisting the patent lien was "a misunderstanding."
Panel members, my ex-wife is simply bitter over our divorce! I co-built NovaAI from scratch—I had every right to negotiate financing!
Really? Then explain the 11:39 PM datacenter CCTV, the $2M wire on divorce night, and your smashed phone’s GPS lock inside Rack 3.
[at the witness stand] He’s lying! I submitted the 2022 email proving Ethan stole the v1 prototype from {{player_name}}’s professor—and begged my father for $2M to short NovaAI!
Every single commissioner just slammed their folders shut! They’re issuing a lifetime market ban on the spot!

nodes.prompt: The Tribunal Chair asks if you have a closing remark for the record:

options.label: Clear your late professor’s name publicly
options.player_reply_text: Let the official record show: NovaAI’s core architecture was born in Professor Vance’s lab—and today it is permanently protected from thieves.

options.label: Lock NovaAI’s dual-key governance charter
options.player_reply_text: Effective today, NovaAI adopts an open cryptographic governance charter—no single executive can ever pledge shareholder IP in secret again.

nodes.text: The entire tribunal gallery just broke into applause! That statement will be quoted in textbooks!
Analysts just upgraded NovaAI to "Strong Buy" across the board—our stock just hit an all-time high!
The Chair’s gavel strikes three times: lifetime securities bans for Ethan and Serena’s father, and immediate referral for criminal arrest.
Economic police are stepping onto the floor right now—watch Ethan’s final exit.

nodes.headline: Handcuffs At The Exchange
nodes.teaser_text: Cameras capture the ultimate karmic finale as the man who dumped you before the IPO is led out in steel.

nodes.text: 3:00 PM · Exchange Plaza Steps. Afternoon sunlight glints off steel handcuffs as economic police escort Ethan and Serena’s father past a sea of reporters.
Done and dusted! Ethan faces fifteen years for corporate espionage, forgery, and market manipulation—with zero bail.
The court gave me probation and seized our trust fund. I’m leaving the city tonight, {{player_name}}... I finally understand why you never flinched.
Because when you actually build something with your own mind and hands, nobody can ever take it from you.
And look at the closing ticker: NovaAI just closed at $4.1 billion valuation—and tomorrow’s Global Tech Summit wants YOU as the opening keynote!

nodes.prompt: Before tomorrow’s grand headquarters launch, how do you reward your engineering team?

options.label: Grant every coder a $100K stock bonus
options.player_reply_text: Every engineer who stood guard with me overnight gets an immediate founder-tier equity grant!

options.label: Rename the core AI after your professor
options.player_reply_text: Rename our flagship engine "Vance-Core" and launch a $500M Women-in-STEM Endowment from our Apex Cayman restitution!

nodes.text: The engineering floor just exploded in cheers! Applications to join NovaAI just jumped 800%!
Pure class! Universities worldwide are already calling to partner with the new endowment!
You step out onto the sunlit terrace of your new glass headquarters, free of the past and standing at the summit of global tech.
Tomorrow morning, we open the doors to NovaAI’s future—on my terms alone.

nodes.headline: Dawn Of A Tech Empress
nodes.teaser_text: One final morning ceremony awaits—where the woman Ethan tried to erase claims the world stage forever.

nodes.text: 10:00 AM · NovaAI Glass Campus Grand Opening. Bright morning sunlight floods the skybridge as global tech leaders, students, and journalists pack the atrium.
Not a single empty seat in the house, CEO {{player_name}}! NovaAI just crossed $5 billion—and you still hold 51% super-voting control!
One week ago, someone handed me divorce papers and a tiny payout because he thought I was "just the quiet wife who typed code at home."
Today, every line of that code powers the fastest-growing AI company on earth—and funds a thousand young builders who will never let anyone dim their light.
Wait—check the envelope the University Dean just placed on the podium! Your late professor left a sealed letter for the day his patent went public!

nodes.prompt: You unseal your mentor’s final letter under the spotlight:

options.label: Read his blessing aloud to the crowd
options.player_reply_text: He wrote: "To {{player_name}}, the sharpest mind I ever taught—never shrink to fit someone else’s ambition. Build your own sky."

options.label: Launch NovaAI Open-Research Lab live
options.player_reply_text: In honor of my mentor’s letter, press the glass console with me—NovaAI’s Open-Research Lab is officially live for every dreamer on earth!

nodes.text: A two-minute standing ovation! Every student in the front row is cheering your name!
Golden holo-lights just illuminated the entire skybridge! That was the greatest tech keynote of the decade!
Sunlight gleams across the NovaAI emblem as you raise your head—no longer anyone’s shadow, now the undisputed Sovereign of Tech.
The opening bell is ours—today, tomorrow, and every decade to come.

nodes.headline: Grand Finale · Sovereign Of Tech
nodes.teaser_text: The hostile short-attack is obliterated, Ethan and his syndicate are behind bars, and you reign over a $5B empire built on your own brilliance.
